fato_historico: 1942: World War II: A Japanese floatplane drops incendiary bombs on Oregon.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to cultivate inner peace, much like the gentle rhythm of the tides. Even when distant embers glow on the horizon, your heart remains a sanctuary of warmth. It is a good time to nurture your connections, practice deep kindness, and consider how your emotional resilience shines brightly like a lucky four-leaf clover in the grass.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is the strongest compass guiding you through every shifting tide.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing mastery, intuition, and building beautiful foundations.
conselho: Trust your intuition and let your natural empathy guide your choices today.
